settings.title: Disable content analysis for product improvement
settings.description: Adobe analyzes cloud content using ML to improve products. ON by default for individual accounts. Business/team accounts auto-opted-out.

settings.title: Set Content Credentials 'do not train' preference
settings.description: Attach Content Credentials to files with a 'do not train' signal. Adobe states it doesn't train Firefly on CC subscriber content, but this adds an explicit signal.

settings.title: Enable two-step verification
settings.description: Supports Adobe Account Access app, authenticator apps, email, SMS. Not enabled by default.

settings.title: Disable desktop app usage information sharing
settings.description: Adobe collects usage information from desktop apps. Can be disabled for individual accounts.

settings.title: Review and revoke third-party app access
settings.description: Third-party apps with Adobe OAuth access can read account info and assets. Review periodically.
